commands.description: Sub-agents draft a full build plan before any code is written.
Loops the agent until a written goal is met; can run for hours.
Launches background/parallel agent sessions.
Audits the generated code for issues.
Generates or edits an image with the Nano Banana (Gemini) model.
Runs a YC-style office-hours feedback session (GStack).
Produces a startup/project plan (GStack).
Pressure-tests a decision from a CEO's perspective (GStack).
Runs a quality-assurance pass over the work (GStack).
Consults a panel of cloned domain experts before acting.
Clear the conversation history and reset the context window.
Switch the active model (e.g. Opus / Sonnet) for the session.
List and invoke installed Claude Code skills.
Compresses the current conversation context window so Claude Code stops re-reading full chat history on every message, reducing token consumption.
Set up a cron job workflow automation that triggers Claude Code to wake up and execute work autonomously at specified intervals
Ask a side question that appears in an overlay without adding to or consuming the main context window
Full codebase audit using shadcn/improve: fans across nine quality categories and writes a self-contained execution plan for a cheaper model to carry out.
Quick-pass audit of the codebase, producing a prioritized plan faster than the full audit.
Exhaustive deep audit across all nine quality dimensions: correctness, security, performance, test coverage, tech debt, dependencies, DX, docs, and feature direction.
Focused security audit of the codebase, generating a remediation plan.
Generate a self-contained execution plan for a described change, with file paths, code excerpts, and verification commands.
Execute a previously generated plan file, intended to be run with a cheaper model after the frontier model wrote the plan.
Update and verify previously created plans against the current state of the codebase.
Runs SkillSmith plugin to discover, scaffold, distill, or audit Claude Code skills; supports subcommands: discover, scaffold, distill, audit
Launches the UGC Factory interview workflow: collects product, offer, creator specs, then generates a complete UGC video ad using Higgsfield Element + Seedance 2.0 + ffmpeg.
Ports a skill from one AI coding harness to the other (Claude Code → Codex or vice versa), adapting folder paths while preserving YAML frontmatter
Adjusts reasoning effort level in Claude Code; tab to Ultracode for xhigh reasoning with automatic multi-agent orchestration (up to 1,000 subagents, adversarial verification)
